description: NIST's CTC-04 (real/nist-ctc-04, its file read in place) cut by a box 0.02 across at the oracle's centroid: every face of both operands is split before any is classified, and the split of the part's f393, a plane bounded by B-spline edges and pierced by four circles, which no section crosses, fails with Fault::Split, a cycle of its arrangement that does not turn once. The part itself reads checker-green at Full. Shrunk from the battery of real/nist-ctc-04, whose every cut and drill meets it; the file is not shrunk further (ADR-0026 §4)
